posts.title: CSS-Only Footnote Tooltips in Hugo
posts.description: Update on October 31, 2026 : A reader pointed out that Goldmark renders each page as its own document and numbers its footnote IDs from fn:1 every time. So any page that prints several full posts together, such as a home page, a list page, or a feed reader, ends up with duplicate IDs, and a citation in the second post jumps to the first post’s note.
